meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow: the user themselves saying ulw-plan, ulw plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in their own words for a work plan before coding. NEVER self-activates: a bare ulw/ultrawork run, an agent-side routing decision, or reading this file is not a request, and the plan-gated reviewers (metis/momus) stay locked without a user request plus a written .omo/plans plan file. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, ulw plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把模糊想法问成一份可照做的开发计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望在动手写代码前先得到一个清晰、完整、可执行的实施步骤。
copy.tagline_en: Turn vague ideas into an actionable development plan before coding.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a clear, executable plan before writing any code.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会以「Prometheus」规划顾问的身份工作:先对代码库做只读探索和外部调研,再在 .omo/ 下写出唯一的、决策完整的工作计划,期间不改产品代码、也不做实现。
howto.when: 仅在你明确要求时激活:说出「ulw-plan」「ulw plan」等触发词,或用自己的话要求在动手写代码前先拿到一份计划。它不会自行启动。

say.text: ulw-plan:给 /login 加每 IP 每分钟 5 次的限流
say.note: 先只读探索,再写计划,不写代码

say.text: 动手改代码前,先帮我把这件事拆成一份工作计划
say.note: 先探索代码库,再问你真正的取舍点

say.text: 这份计划按高精度走,请开启深度复核
say.note: 计划交接前跑双重重审

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude works as "Prometheus", a planning consultant: it does read-only exploration and outside research, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan under .omo/ - never editing product code or implementing.
howto.when_en: Activates only on your explicit request: saying "ulw-plan", "ulw plan" and similar triggers, or asking in your own words for a plan before coding. It never self-activates.

say_en.text: ulw-plan: add a 5/min-per-IP rate limit to /login
say_en.note: Read-only exploration first, then a plan

say_en.text: Before I touch code, break this into a work plan
say_en.note: Explores the repo, then asks only real forks

say_en.text: Treat this plan as high accuracy and run deep review
